title: Survey Builder
subtitle: Build surveys for lead registration
empty_body: Create a survey for your registration form
delete_survey_body: All questions and answers will be deleted.

form_survey.heading: Application form survey
form_survey.body: The questions asked at the start of the public application form, before the applicant's own details. Leave it on “No survey” to skip that step entirely.
